invariants.rationale: Padding values are typically non-negative, so their sum should also be non-negative.
This matches the method's implementation and javadoc: result is defined as the sum of padLeft and padRight.
Since padRight.get(this) is expected to be non-negative, result should be at least as large as padLeft.get(this).
Similarly, as padLeft.get(this) is expected to be non-negative, result should be at least as large as padRight.get(this).
The result is expected to equal the sum of the two pad values obtained via their accessors, as implied by the javadoc.
